heuristics.statement: For the two recorded hyperelliptic branches over F_(p^6), the number Z(p) of zero-support signed ordinary trace classes may stay below 24p.
heuristics.scope: The exact two-branch trace domain t congruent 2 mod 4; finite forecast, not an asymptotic theorem.
heuristics.falsifier: One complete independently verified two-branch census at a prime p with Z(p)>24p refutes the finite forecast.

heuristics.statement: After freezing the selected CM-order mass H_B(t) and sample count M_B, class zero frequencies may be approximated by exp(-M_B H_B(t)/sum H_B).
heuristics.scope: Class-uniform ordinary traces and separately specified branch, exceptional units and twist law; proposed statistical model.
heuristics.calibration: The parent hypothesis fixes mu bins [0,1), [1,2), [2,4), [4,8), [8,infinity) and a 1/5 absolute calibration forecast for bins with at least 30 rows.
heuristics.falsifier: A frozen independent validation split violating the preregistered calibration forecast in an eligible bin.

heuristics.statement: Small maximal-order class number is a possible occupancy covariate, but class number alone does not determine whether the cubic branch has a representative.
heuristics.scope: The p41 cubic norm-one diagnostic only; not a complete predictor or exact theorem.
heuristics.calibration: At p=41, traces 137406 and 137410 have equal Frobenius 2-depth 3, equal 2-splitting flag 1 and h_K=414 in the saved class-number rows; representative counts are 0 and 12. The latter is positive under the randomized counter.
heuristics.falsifier: The displayed pair refutes any rule depending only on those three recorded covariates; statistical usefulness requires held-out calibration.

heuristics.statement: Every two-branch zero row lies within 64p of the Hasse boundary, i.e. 2p^3-|t|<=64p.
heuristics.scope: The seven complete two-branch ordinary trace censuses.
heuristics.calibration: 1,184 of 2,074 zero rows violate the strip. At p=7, t=+22 and t=-22 have gap 664>448.
heuristics.falsifier: The complete p7 oracle already contains the counterexamples.
